extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Tasks Table shows the tasks from every note in your vault in one table, in the style of Obsidian Bases.
problem: Users often struggle to find and manage tasks scattered across numerous notes within a vault.

relations.evidence: in the style of Obsidian Bases.
Reads the Obsidian Tasks emoji format

summary: Tasks Table aggregates tasks from all notes into a single, customizable table, allowing users to view, filter, and manage them like a database.
